title: Shelf hover falls below the Classic Light contrast floors
detail:
Shelf hover falls below the Classic Light contrast floors

An off-screen entry in Classic Light drops to 4.13:1 label contrast and 2.56:1 approval mark contrast when hovered, below the agreed 4.5:1 and 3:1. Rune darkens the background while the ink remains tuned for rest. Preserve the agreed contrast against the composited background in rest, hover and press. Evidence is on s-2bt4aa.
